summary.name: LICEcap
summary.one_liner: LICEcap is a lightweight, free and open-source screen capture tool that records an area of the desktop as an animated GIF or its own lossless .LCF format.
use_cases: record a short demo of software as an animated GIF
capture part of the desktop for sharing in web browsers
record screen actions to an LCF file for REAPER playback
convert a screen capture to GIF or other video format
summary.what_it_does:
LICEcap captures a user-selected area of the desktop and saves it directly to .GIF or its native .LCF format. The capture frame can be moved during recording, and recording can be paused and restarted with optional inserted text messages. A global hotkey (shift+space) toggles pausing, and the maximum framerate is adjustable to limit CPU usage. It can also add a basic title frame, record mouse button presses, and display elapsed time. LCF files can be played back in REAPER or converted to GIF or other video formats.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">open source
notable: Records directly to GIF or lossless .LCF with more than 256 colors per frame
Native .LCF files play back in REAPER
GPL free software with source included in each download
Global shift+space hotkey to pause recording
caveats: Linux support is only reported to work under WINE, not native
Windows versions older than XP/Vista/7 may have reduced functionality; macOS support limited to 10.7-12.x on Intel 64-bit or M1 in this version
Recording to LCF benefits from 1GB+ RAM
